_note: Curated by hand from each form's own first page (MoR API forms, fetched 2026-09-14). Keys are the API form ids. English names and purposes describe what the form itself shows; nothing is added that the form does not say.

6.en: TIN de-registration request (returning the TIN certificate)
6.purpose_en: Used when a business stops: asks the Ministry to take back the TIN certificate. It asks for the taxpayer's name, TIN, VAT number (if any) and phone, the reason for ceasing business and the date it ceased, the owner's or general manager's name, signature and seal, and has a tax clearance section (tax arrears) that the tax office completes.
6.purpose_am: ንግድ ሥራ ሲቋረጥ የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር (TIN) የምስክር ወረቀቱን ለመመለስ የሚቀርብ ማመልከቻ። የግብር ከፋዩ ስም፣ TIN፣ የተ.እ.ታ ቁጥር (ካለ)፣ ስልክ፣ ንግዱ የቆመበት ምክንያትና ቀን፣ የባለቤቱ ወይም የዋና ሥራ አስኪያጁ ስም፣ ፊርማና ማህተም ይሞላበታል፤ የውዝፍ ግብርና ታክስ እዳ ማጣራት (ክሊራንስ) ክፍልም አለው።

8.en: Individual taxpayer registration form (Federal, Regional and City Administration)
8.purpose_en: Registers an individual as a taxpayer. Type of application: new, change of details, biometric, or replacement TIN card. It asks for the existing TIN (if any), full name with father's and grandfather's name, date of birth (Gregorian or Ethiopian calendar), country of residence, nationality and country of birth, work permit number for foreigners, occupation (student, employed, trader), home address, main business address and the tax centre.
8.purpose_am: ግለሰብን በግብር ከፋይነት ለመመዝገብ። የማመልከቻው ዓይነት፦ አዲስ፣ የመረጃ ለውጥ፣ ባዮሜትሪክ ወይም የTIN ካርድ ምትክ። ስም እስከ አያት፣ የትውልድ ቀን (በኢትዮጵያ ወይም በፈረንጅ አቆጣጠር)፣ ዜግነት፣ ለውጭ ዜጎች የሥራ ፈቃድ ቁጥር፣ ሥራ፣ የመኖሪያና የንግድ አድራሻ ይሞላበታል።

7.purpose_en: Registers a company or other organisation as a taxpayer: past registration details (earlier TIN, legal and trade name, commercial licence and principal registration numbers), then the new business details and legal status (private limited company, share company, joint venture, partnership, holding company, public enterprise, cooperative, NGO, religious organisation, micro and small enterprise, diplomatic mission, other). Its first page lists what to bring for a new TIN certificate, including the name registration, the memorandum of association authenticated by the documents registration office, recent photos and a renewed resident ID of the general manager, the shareholders' TIN and Fayda numbers, and an authenticated lease in the company's name.
7.purpose_am: ድርጅትን በግብር ከፋይነት ለመመዝገብ የሚቀርብ ማመልከቻ። የቀድሞ ምዝገባ መረጃ (TIN፣ ሕጋዊና የንግድ ስም፣ የንግድ ፈቃድ ቁጥር)፣ የአዲሱ ድርጅት መረጃና ሕጋዊ አደረጃጀት (ኃ/የተ/የግል ማህበር፣ አክሲዮን ማህበር፣ የሽርክና ማህበር፣ የሕብረት ሥራ ማህበር ወዘተ) ይሞላበታል። የመጀመሪያ ገጹ አዲስ TIN ሰርተፍኬት ለማውጣት የሚያስፈልጉ ሰነዶችን ይዘረዝራል፤ ለምሳሌ በውልና ማስረጃ የፀደቀ መመስረቻ ጽሁፍ፣ የዋና ሥራ አስኪያጁ ፎቶና የታደሰ መታወቂያ፣ የባለአክሲዮኖች TIN እና የፋይዳ ቁጥር፣ በድርጅቱ ስም የፀደቀ የቤት ኪራይ ውል።

9.en: Taxpayer registration updating form (change of address, name or other registration details)
9.purpose_en: Reports a change to a taxpayer's registration. For a change of address or name its first page lists: the completed form with the organisation's seal, an authenticated copy of the minutes the members agreed, a copy of the main registration and trade licence changed to the new address, the original TIN and VAT certificates, an authenticated copy of the lease, the bank account number and branch, and a direct line telephone number.
9.purpose_am: የግብር ከፋይ ምዝገባ መረጃ ለውጥ (አድራሻ፣ ስም ወዘተ) ለማሳወቅ። ለአድራሻ ወይም ለስም ለውጥ የሚያስፈልጉት፦ የተሞላ ቅጽ ከድርጅቱ ማህተም ጋር፣ አባላቱ የተስማሙበት በውልና ማስረጃ የፀደቀ ቃለጉባኤ ኮፒ፣ በአዲሱ አድራሻ የተቀየረ ዋና ምዝገባና ንግድ ፈቃድ ኮፒ፣ ዋናው የቲን እና የቫት ሰርተፊኬት፣ የፀደቀ የቤት ኪራይ ውል ኮፒ፣ የባንክ ሂሳብ ቁጥርና ቅርንጫፍ፣ ቀጥታ የመስመር ስልክ ቁጥር።

2.purpose_en: Registers a business for value added tax. It asks for the taxpayer's name, TIN and trade name, address (region, city, sub-city, woreda, kebele, house number), P.O. box, telephone, fax and e-mail, the date business commenced, the type of business activities, and the business legal status (public enterprise, share company, private limited company, joint venture, sole proprietor, cooperative, partnership, other). This scan still carries the former Ethiopian Revenues and Customs Authority heading and says to fill it in duplicate.
2.purpose_am: ለተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ (ቫት) ለመመዝገብ የሚቀርብ ማመልከቻ። የግብር ከፋዩ ስም፣ TIN፣ የንግድ ስም፣ አድራሻ፣ ስልክና ኢሜይል፣ ንግዱ የተጀመረበት ቀን፣ የሥራው ዓይነትና የድርጅቱ ሕጋዊ ሁኔታ ይሞላበታል። በሁለት ቅጂ ይሞላል፤ ቅጹ የቀድሞው የኢትዮጵያ ገቢዎችና ጉምሩክ ባለሥልጣን ስም ያለበት ስካን ነው።

18.purpose_en: The periodic VAT return: date of filing, return type (original or revised), the tax period, the registered taxpayer's name, TIN, sub-TIN and VAT registration number, and details of the tax agent when an agent prepared the return.
18.purpose_am: የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ ማሳወቂያ (ቫት ሪተርን)፦ ያሳወቁበት ቀን፣ ዋና ወይም የተከለሰ ማሳወቂያ፣ የግብር ጊዜ፣ የግብር ከፋዩ ስም፣ TIN እና የቫት ምዝገባ ቁጥር፣ እንዲሁም ማሳወቂያው በታክስ ወኪል ከተዘጋጀ የወኪሉ መረጃ።

17.en: VAT and buyer-withheld VAT declaration form (with detailed transaction schedule)
17.purpose_en: The VAT declaration that also reports VAT withheld by the buyer. Its first page is the Ministry's cover letter: after Proclamation 1157/2011 amended VAT Proclamation 285/1994 and Directive 60/2012 on VAT withheld by the buyer was issued, the VAT declaration form and the detailed transaction schedule were changed, to be used from Megabit 1, 2012 E.C. on SIGTAS; the changes include the taxpayer's VAT withholding, the value of capital goods, and a 50% withholding of the VAT on transactions.
17.purpose_am: የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ እና በገዢው ተይዞ የሚከፈል የተ.እ.ታ ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ ከዝርዝር የግብይት መረጃ መግለጫ ጋር። የመጀመሪያ ገጹ የሚኒስቴሩ ደብዳቤ ነው፤ በአዋጅ 1157/2011 እና በመመሪያ 60/2012 መሠረት የተሻሻለው ቅጽ ከመጋቢት 1 ቀን 2012 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ በSIGTAS ላይ ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን ይገልጻል።

16.en: Report of VAT withheld by the buyer and paid to the tax authority (reverse taxation on services from non-residents)
16.purpose_en: Reports VAT that a buyer deducted and paid to the tax authority under the reverse-taxation rule for services received from non-residents: the taxpayer's TIN, name, address and VAT number, the declaration period, and for each transaction the type of service, the value before VAT and the VAT withheld and paid. The Amharic heading cites Article 23(4) and 21(1) of VAT Proclamation 285/1995 E.C.; the English heading cites Article 23(4) of VAT Proclamation 1341/2016 E.C. The Ministry's own file name marks it as the old-proclamation version.
16.purpose_am: ነዋሪ ካልሆነ ሰው በተገኘ አገልግሎት ላይ ገዢው ተይዞ የቀነሰውንና ለባለሥልጣኑ የከፈለውን የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ (reverse taxation) ሪፖርት ማድረጊያ ቅጽ። የግብር ከፋዩ መረጃ፣ የማስታወቂያ ጊዜ፣ የአገልግሎቱ ዓይነት፣ ከቫት በፊት ያለው ዋጋና የተቀነሰው ቫት ይሞላበታል።

19.purpose_en: Filed by a person or organisation that withholds VAT: withholder's name, address, TIN, tax account number, tax centre and withholding month, then for each payment the withholdee's TIN, name and address, the taxable amount, the tax withheld, and the receipt number and date.
19.purpose_am: ቫት ቀንሶ የሚያስቀር ሰው ወይም ድርጅት የሚያቀርበው ማሳወቂያ (በእንግሊዝኛ)፦ የቀናሹ መረጃ፣ የወሩ ጊዜ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ ክፍያ የተከፋዩ TIN፣ ስምና አድራሻ፣ ግብር የሚከፈልበት መጠን፣ የተቀነሰው ታክስና የደረሰኝ ቁጥርና ቀን።

20.en: Withholding tax declaration on payment (Amharic and English, under Proclamation 1395/2025)
20.purpose_en: Filed monthly by a withholder of income tax on payments: the withholder's name, TIN, tax account number, tax centre and tax period, and the payments and tax withheld. The Ministry's file name says it is based on Proclamation 1395/2017 E.C. (2025) and is to be used from Nehase 1, 2017 E.C.
20.purpose_am: ከተከፋይ ሂሳብ ላይ የተቀነሰ ግብር ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ፦ ግብር ቀንሶ ገቢ አድራጊው ስም፣ TIN፣ የግብር ሒሳብ ቁጥር፣ የግብር ሰብሳቢ ጽ/ቤትና የታክስ ጊዜ፣ ክፍያዎችና የተቀነሰው ግብር። የሚኒስቴሩ የፋይል ስም በአዋጅ 1395/2017 መሠረት ከነሐሴ 1 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ እንደሚሠራበት ይገልጻል።

21.purpose_en: English version of the withholding tax on payment declaration: the withholder's details and withholding month, then each withholdee's TIN, name and address, the taxable amount, the tax withheld and the receipt number.
21.purpose_am: ከክፍያ ላይ የተቀነሰ ግብር ማሳወቂያ (የእንግሊዝኛ ቅጂ)፦ የቀናሹ መረጃና ወር፣ የተከፋዩ TIN፣ ስምና አድራሻ፣ ግብር የሚከፈልበት መጠን፣ የተቀነሰው ግብርና የደረሰኝ ቁጥር።

14.en: Excise tax declaration form and detailed transaction schedule
14.purpose_en: The excise tax declaration. Its first page is the Ministry's cover letter: the new Excise Tax Proclamation 1186/2012 E.C. changed the former Proclamation 307/1995, so the excise declaration form and the detailed transaction schedule were revised, to be used from the first of Tir 2014 E.C. (as printed); the following pages are the form and schedule.
14.purpose_am: የኤክሳይዝ ታክስ ማሳወቂያ ቅጽና ዝርዝር የግብይት መረጃ መግለጫ። የመጀመሪያ ገጹ በአዲሱ የኤክሳይዝ ታክስ አዋጅ 1186/2012 መሠረት ቅጹ መሻሻሉን የሚገልጽ የሚኒስቴሩ ደብዳቤ ነው።

13.purpose_en: The balance sheet filed with a Schedule B rental income tax, Schedule C business income tax or mining income tax declaration: taxpayer information, then business assets, liabilities and capital, completed after the individual annexes.
13.purpose_am: ከሠንጠረዥ 'ለ' (የቤት ኪራይ)፣ ሠንጠረዥ 'ሐ' (የንግድ ሥራ) ወይም የማዕድን ገቢ ግብር ማሳወቂያ ጋር የሚቀርብ የሀብትና ዕዳ መግለጫ (ባላንስ ሺት) እና አባሪዎቹ (በእንግሊዝኛ)።

24.en: Schedule C business income tax declaration — consolidated form for banks
24.purpose_en: Schedule C business income tax declaration for banks (companies and individuals that keep books of account): taxpayer information, then the tax declaration lines such as total income from banking operations, net interest income, fees and commission income, net trading income from financial instruments and gross investment income.
24.purpose_am: በባንክ ሥራ ለተሰማሩ ግብር ከፋዮች የተጠቃለለ የሠንጠረዥ 'ሐ' የንግድ ሥራ ገቢ ግብር ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ፦ ከባንክ ሥራ የተገኘ ጠቅላላ ገቢ፣ የተጣራ የወለድ ገቢ፣ የክፍያና የኮሚሽን ገቢ ወዘተ።

25.en: Schedule C business income tax declaration — per line of business, for banks
25.purpose_en: Sector-based Schedule C business income tax declaration for banks: the financial report for each line of business, for taxpayers that keep books of account.
25.purpose_am: የባንክ ሥራ ለሚሠሩ ግብር ከፋዮች በእያንዳንዱ የንግድ ሥራ መስክ የሂሳብ ሪፖርት ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ (ሠንጠረዥ 'ሐ')።

12.en: Schedule C business income tax declaration — form for insurance companies
12.purpose_en: Sector-based Schedule C business income tax declaration for insurance companies that keep books of account: taxpayer information and the financial report by line of business. The Ministry lists it as the consolidated declaration form for insurance.
12.purpose_am: በኢንሹራንስ ሥራ ለተሰማሩ ግብር ከፋዮች የሠንጠረዥ 'ሐ' የንግድ ሥራ ገቢ ግብር ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ።

23.en: Schedule C business income tax declaration — per line of business, for general trade and commission
23.purpose_en: Listed by the Ministry as the per-line-of-business financial report declaration for taxpayers in general trade and/or commission work.
23.purpose_am: የጠቅላላ ንግድ እና/ወይም የኮሚሽን ሥራ ለሚሠሩ ግብር ከፋዮች በእያንዳንዱ የንግድ ሥራ መስክ የሂሳብ ሪፖርት ማሳወቂያ ቅጽ።
